name: Core journeys
expected_method_and_evidence: Integration/browser tests submit, assign, progress, request information, reply and close. Check correct state, ownership, timestamps and history.

name: Horizontal access
expected_method_and_evidence: Student A tries B's case, message and timeline identifiers through direct and list endpoints. No content, counts or existence clues returned.

name: Staff scope
expected_method_and_evidence: Unassigned same-team officer, unrelated manager and administrator attempt sensitive reads and mutations. Denied. Assigned officer and scoped manager succeed.

name: Triage and referral
expected_method_and_evidence: Queue returns only approved metadata. Expired claim denied. Target receives selected referral summary, never source notes. Concurrent acceptance creates exactly one target case.

name: Notes separation
expected_method_and_evidence: Seed distinctive synthetic note text; verify it is absent from student HTML, responses, timeline, notification payloads and captured logs.

name: Identity and sessions
expected_method_and_evidence: Reject invalid OIDC state/nonce/issuer/audience, expired responses and unsafe return URLs. Verify cookie flags, rotation, timeout, logout and immediate next-request deactivation. No credentials in logs.

name: Input attacks
expected_method_and_evidence: Try operator objects, unexpected owner/role fields, oversized values, malformed IDs and script payloads. Reject unsafe shapes; render accepted text inertly.

name: CSRF and methods
expected_method_and_evidence: Missing or invalid CSRF cannot create, message, assign, close or grant roles. GET requests leave business state unchanged.

name: Workflow restrictions
expected_method_and_evidence: Parameterised allowed/forbidden transition tests; closure requires outcome; student cannot set status; unassigned work cannot start; manager-only reopening.

name: Atomicity and concurrency
expected_method_and_evidence: Use a real test replica set. Inject failures between writes: no partial case/event/audit/outbox state. Two simultaneous versioned writes produce one success and one conflict. Repeat submission produces one case.

name: Audit and roles
expected_method_and_evidence: Verify required fields for reads, changes, denials and grants. Ordinary credentials cannot alter audit records. Self-approval rejected. Audit failure blocks sensitive response or mutation safely.

name: Worker failures
expected_method_and_evidence: Simulate provider outage, lease expiry and crash after send. Business state persists; retries are bounded; stale jobs alert; duplicate sends expose no extra information.

name: Performance and abuse
expected_method_and_evidence: Run stated dataset and workload; report p50/p95, throughput, unexpected errors and query behaviour. Test rate limits behind the proxy with shared state and correct client attribution.

name: Accessibility
expected_method_and_evidence: Proposed target WCAG 2.2 AA for core journeys. Automated checks plus keyboard, focus, labels, errors, contrast, zoom and screen-reader review. Record tested coverage rather than claim full conformance from an automated score.

name: Recovery and retention
expected_method_and_evidence: Restore encrypted backup in isolation, measure RPO/RTO, verify integrity, reapply disposal records, invalidate restored sessions and prevent old outbox jobs sending. Confirm holds block disposal.

name: Release configuration
expected_method_and_evidence: Check HTTPS, trusted proxy/hosts, security headers, no-store, private database, restricted credentials, debugger off, dependency/secret scans and clean installation from the submission ZIP.
